exemplars.note: Sheet scores: conceptual 0, critical 0, applied 1, governance 0. Conceptual is 0 because the text only says the firm will incorporate, use, and roll out AI and is seeing efficiencies, with no capability, product, data, or technical requirement. Applied is 1 because reps using AI is a stated use, not a worked workflow or a measured outcome. Critical and governance are 0.
